question: Tell me about wildfire incidents in Sacramento County during 2024
answer_text: CAL FIRE recorded 11 wildfire incidents in Sacramento County during 2024 under the default incident-type filter. This count excludes untyped events (1,234 statewide records without incident type) and utility-tagged incidents (282 records without utility data), so it does not represent all fire events. One example is the Marsh Fire.
qualification_texts: CAL FIRE has 1,234 records without incident type and 282 without utility tags; default counts include only Wildfire/Fire incident types.

question: Tell me about CPUC ignitions in 2023
answer_text: CPUC recorded 480 utility-caused ignitions in California for 2023 under the default filters. This count represents utility-attributed ignitions only and excludes non-utility causes, as noted in the caveats. The dataset includes 480 total events with 5 returned examples from January 2023, but the number does not represent all-cause wildfire counts or comparable metrics to CAL FIRE or US ignitions.
qualification_texts: CPUC ignitions in this warehouse are utility-caused / utility-attributed only; they are not all-cause wildfire counts and are not comparable to CAL FIRE or US ignitions.
